question.text: The differential equation of all the ellipses centred at the origin and have axes as the co-ordinate axes is

options.text:
$x^{2} y^{\prime}+x y^{\prime \prime}-3 y=0$
Where $y^{\prime} \equiv \frac{d y}{d x}, y^{\prime \prime} \equiv \frac{d^{2} y}{d x^{2}}$

solution.text: equation of ellipse centred at origin and have axes as the coordinate axes is $\frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}}+\frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}}=1$ $\Rightarrow \frac{x}{a^{2}}+\frac{y y^{\prime}}{b^{2}}=0$ $\Rightarrow \quad \frac{-b^{2}}{a^{2}}=\frac{y y^{\prime}}{x}$ $\Rightarrow \quad 0=\frac{x\left(y^{\prime \prime} y^{\prime}+y^{\prime 2}\right)-y y^{\prime}}{x^{2}}$
